pages.text: A little bell hung at Ddori's ankle. Every move made it jingle.
Today a boat selling red fruit arrived. Bung took Ddori's hand and stood up. "Let us choose the reddest ones!"
They boarded the fruit boat. Fruit piled high. A kitten meowed in the net pile beside it.
Bung turned fruit over to look, quietly letting go of that hand. Ddori watched the kitten.
Bung found the reddest fruit. "Look, Ddori!" But Ddori was not beside Bung.
Bung searched every side. So many boats! It was hard to tell where anything was.
Bung's heart pounded. Hands cupped round the mouth, Bung called Ddori.
Mom held Bung's shoulders still and put a hand to her own ear.
Jingle, jingle. Behind the nets! Ddori sat snug beside the kitten.
Bung put Ddori right in front. Together, they each chose the reddest fruit.
